paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance metrics of Recall, Precision, and F1 Score for different SQL models labeled as DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as Recall, Precision, and F1 Score, while the vertical axis is labeled with a scale from 40 to 100, divided into intervals of 20 units, indicating percentage measurements. The chart contains groups of three bars for each category with some white space between the bars. In the Recall category, the light blue bar representing DIN-SQL (zero-shot) is approximately 63.58, the blue bar for TA-SQL (zero-shot) is about 71.90, and the green bar for DIN-SQL (few-shot) is around 72.29. In the Precision category, the light blue bar has a value of approximately 88.89, the blue bar is about 91.24, and the green bar is around 92.31. For the F1 Score category, the light blue bar is approximately 75.34, the blue bar is around 80.40, and the green bar is about 81.08. The bars are colored differently according to the legend, where light blue represents DIN-SQL (zero-shot), blue represents TA-SQL (zero-shot), and green represents DIN-SQL (few-shot). The bars are not sorted in a specific order beyond the category grouping, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend is given at top.
